title: Post-replicative chromatin accessibility predicts cell fate change
comparison_or_design: The naïve-to-primed differentiation chromatin-accessibility experiment, including its matched chromatin preparations.
observations_or_assays: Replication-coupled ATAC sequencing; The matched bulk/unreplicated ATAC controls for this same differentiation branch
time_scope: 0, 9 and 48 hours after the switch to EpiLC induction conditions.
excluded: MEF reprogramming, proliferation-dye sorting and other experiments in GSE296014
Flow cytometry, independent motif/ChIP datasets and accessibility result matrices
population_or_material: Mouse ESC/EpiLC preparations in the naïve-to-primed differentiation branch.
requested_items: Differentiation induction time, EdU/replication-labelling schedule and replication-coupled versus bulk chromatin preparation
